entries.reasoning: Under Northwind Logistics clause 9.2 and S1.2, all intellectual property rights in Deliverables including pre-existing tools such as PipeKit were assigned absolutely to Northwind Logistics upon payment. In § 6.1, § 6.2, and § 6.3 of the new contract, AtliQ incorporates PipeKit, grants a license to PipeKit, and warrants that it is the sole owner of all intellectual property rights in PipeKit. This directly collides with the prior absolute assignment to Northwind Logistics.

incomingClauses.quote: Supplier shall deliver the services using its proprietary data-pipeline accelerator "PipeKit", comprising reusable ingestion connectors, transformation templates, data quality rule libraries and orchestration modules. PipeKit shall be incorporated into the Work Results to reduce implementation time and cost.

Supplier hereby grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to use, reproduce, modify and operate PipeKit as incorporated in the Work Results, for the purposes of operating, maintaining and further developing the Platform, including for the benefit of Client's customers. Client may sub-license this right to its affiliated companies and to service providers acting on its behalf.

Supplier warrants that it is the sole owner of all intellectual property rights in PipeKit, that it is entitled to grant the rights set out in § 6.2, and that PipeKit and its use under this Agreement do not infringe any rights of third parties.

entries.suggestedChange: Counsel to evaluate title to PipeKit under the Northwind Logistics agreement; if title is impaired, seek consent/waiver from Northwind Logistics, or renegotiate § 6 and Annex 2 (M1) to remove PipeKit and deliver the pipeline using bespoke or open-source software.
entries.impact: Collides with the Northwind Logistics assignment of PipeKit, which is perpetual and live.
